# Stroka — Financial Ledger & Subscription Intelligence (INR)

> Stroka is a privacy-first expense, subscription, and tax management ledger built specifically for individuals, freelancers, and businesses in India. It partitions personal living subscriptions from corporate software expenses, tracks 18% GST deductibility, and exports Chartered Accountant-ready Tax Summaries in native Indian Rupees (₹ INR).

## Core Capabilities

- **Personal & Business Dual Ledgers**: Strictly separates personal lifestyle subscriptions (Netflix, Spotify, gym) from business SaaS tools (AWS, Google Workspace, GitHub).
- **Tax Summary Engine**: Generates comprehensive Tax Summaries covering up to 400 days per request and up to 20,000 tagged rows per report. Documents 18% GST rates, vendor GSTIN verification, and HSN/SAC code categorizations.
- **Smart Renewal Reminders**: Proactive alerts (1, 3, 7, or 14 days in advance) before auto-debits execute on credit cards or UPI AutoPay.
- **Past Invoice & Billing History**: Historical archive of invoice numbers, dates, payment modes, and receipts.
- **Data Protection**: Encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and encrypted at rest (AES-256). Zero advertising telemetry; financial patterns are never packaged or brokered.

## Plans & Pricing (in ₹ INR)

- **Free Tier (₹0 forever)**:
  - Track up to 10 active subscriptions in INR
  - Personal and Business ledger partitioning
  - 10 CSV exports per month
  - Standard 3-day renewal alerts
  - Monthly expense summary report
  - Encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256)

- **Starter Tier (₹99/mo billed annually with 2 months free, or ₹129/mo billed monthly)**:
  - *In addition to Free, you'll get:*
  - Track up to 50 subscriptions (40 more than Free)
  - Expense vs subscription breakdown
  - Custom categories and renewal reminders
  - Full billing history & past invoice registry
  - 100 CSV exports per month (10x Free)
  - Basic PDF exports per month

- **Stroka Pro Tier (₹240/mo billed annually with 2 months free, or ₹299/mo billed monthly)**:
  - *In addition to Starter, you'll get:*
  - Unlimited personal & business subscriptions
  - Tax Summary Engine (Up to 400 days per request)
  - High capacity: Up to 20,000 tagged rows per summary
  - 18% GST expense breakdown & Tax Summaries
  - HSN/SAC code categorization & invoice attachment
  - Chartered Accountant-ready PDF & CSV tax exports
  - Customizable alert lead times (1, 3, 7, or 14 days)
  - Advanced charts
  - 1,000 CSV exports per month
  - Advanced PDF exports per month
  - Saved views (coming soon)
  - Monthly report (coming soon)
  - XLSX exports (coming soon)

## Technical Architecture

- Currency: Indian Rupee (`INR`, symbol `₹`)
- Front-end: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion (Framer Motion v12)
- Security: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, no bank credentials stored
- Contact: support@stroka.in
- Canonical URL: https://truvora-sigma.vercel.app/
